topic: Can we create an environmentally friendly replacement for plastics?
conclusion: Environmentally preferable replacements can be created for selected product functions and waste systems, but no single polymer should be expected to replace every plastic. The scientifically meaningful comparison is equal delivered service under realistic regional end-of-life routing.
key_testable_claims: Equal-service ranking can differ from resin-mass ranking.
Actual collection, sorting, facility access, and leakage can change comparative outcomes.
Additives, coatings, adhesives, multilayers, and product loss can materially alter a base-polymer advantage.
Material-product-end-of-life co-design can find feasible options missed by material-only screening.
